figures.uncertainty_scope: Smooth curves use pointwise 95% patient-cluster bootstrap intervals over the fixed assessment patients (1000 requested draws; at least 900 valid per curve). Curves are restricted to observed p01–p99 support. Constant-score or operational Jeffreys-fallback predictions are shown as their actual mean-prediction/event-rate point with the available patient-cluster interval; no curve is imputed.
figures.assessment_scope: All eligible assessment stays; the same patient-level assessment roles are used for FM and V+P LR within each cohort.

figures.claim: With the historical frozen MIMIC C=1 head fixed, perturbing the repaired eICU embedding changes ranking and proper-score performance relative to observed tokens.
figures.uncertainty_scope: AUROC intervals are paired 95% patient-cluster bootstrap intervals on the full reviewed eICU roster. Brier/log-loss intervals are paired 95% patient-cluster intervals, stay-weighted, conditional on fixed predictions. Negative loss differences favor the perturbation; positive AUROC differences favor it. The historical source head is fixed.
figures.fixed_head: historical frozen MIMIC main20k C=1 source scaler and logistic probe

figures.claim: Same-window numerical recoverability differs between the frozen FM embedding and direct V/B/H token summaries, with source transfer and target-local nested fits shown separately.
figures.uncertainty_scope: Points are the actual R² values for each feature arm on the shared eICU finite-label roster; available intervals are the producer's patient-cluster bootstrap intervals. Where the producer did not provide a finite interval, the point is shown without an interval. Negative R² values are retained. Row labels carry variable-specific stay denominators; no visibility-stratum selection is applied.

figures.claim: The MIMIC source-selected FM regularization sensitivity changes paired Brier and log-loss relative to conventional value-plus-pattern models on the source split and the same repaired target rosters.
figures.uncertainty_scope: Differences are selected-C minus reference losses, stay-weighted on matched assessment rosters. Intervals are the producer's paired 95% patient-cluster bootstrap intervals conditional on frozen scores. Negative differences favor the source-selected candidate. The source panel explicitly contrasts against historical main20k C1; target panels compare the same selected candidate with V+P LR and V+P HGBT.

figures.claim: Across the preselected eICU sites feasible for a 500-patient update, Platt adaptation changes macro site-level Brier and log-loss performance.
figures.uncertainty_scope: Macro stay-weighted loss averages each feasible site equally after averaging 200 adaptation repeats. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals from 1000 shared global eICU patient-cluster resamples; cross-site patients retain one shared multiplicity. The panel title reports selected, feasible, and infeasible site counts.
figures.adaptation_scope: Random within-site adaptation with globally held-out patient assessment; no temporal validation claim.
figures.site_estimand: equal mean of feasible-site stay-weighted losses
figures.fit_failure_note: Failed Platt fits operationally use the prespecified Jeffreys prevalence fallback; per-model counts are attached to the plotted series metadata.

figures.claim: Across all four adaptation budgets, Platt updating changes the paired FM-versus-V+P LR Brier and log-loss gaps in cohort-specific ways.
